(() => {
  const active = document.currentScript;
  const label = active.id;
  scriptChecks[label + "Identity"] = active === document.getElementById(label);
  scriptChecks[label + "Brand"] =
    active instanceof HTMLScriptElement &&
    Object.prototype.toString.call(active) === "[object HTMLScriptElement]";
  scriptChecks[label + "Source"] =
    active.src === new URL(active.getAttribute("src"), document.baseURI).href;
  Promise.resolve().then(() => {
    scriptChecks[label + "MicrotaskNull"] = document.currentScript === null;
  });
  setTimeout(() => {
    scriptChecks[label + "TimerNull"] = document.currentScript === null;
  }, 0);
  active.addEventListener("load", () => {
    scriptChecks[label + "LoadNull"] = document.currentScript === null;
  });
  if (label === "external") {
    active.remove();
    scriptChecks.externalRemoved = document.currentScript === active;
  }
})();
